note: One entry per screenshot on plantoir.app. `build.py` reads alt and caption to write the <picture> element; `website/shots/capture.py` reads `capture` to know how each is produced. Every shot is taken twice, once with the Mac in light appearance and once in dark, and saved as site/img/<id>-light.png and -dark.png.

shots.alt: The Plantoir window listing three courses in a sidebar, with one section open beside it.
shots.caption: Every course and every class section, in one window.

shots.alt: The new course panel, with a course code entered and a summary of the pages about to be created.
shots.caption: Adding a course takes one panel and about a minute.

shots.alt: A class section's settings, showing the colour scheme, typography and publishing choices.
shots.caption: Each section can look and read differently.

shots.alt: A progress view describing, in plain language, the step the site build has reached.
shots.caption: Progress is described in words, not in log output.

shots.alt: A finished class website shown inside the Plantoir window, beside the list of sections.
shots.caption: The site appears in the same window, before anyone else sees it.

shots.alt: The assistant window, showing a request typed in plain English and the change it made in response.
shots.caption: A sentence, rather than a settings panel.

shots.alt: A Grade 10 English class website, with a navigation sidebar, a page of notes and a search field.
shots.caption: What a class sees: ENG2D.

shots.alt: A Grade 12 Calculus and Vectors page showing typeset mathematics.
shots.caption: Mathematics is typeset, not photographed.

shots.alt: A Grade 11 Chemistry page showing a diagram and a table of data.
shots.caption: Diagrams and tables come straight from the notes.

shots.alt: The same class website at phone width, with the navigation collapsed behind a button.
shots.caption: The same site on a phone.
